preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 1 and 123456 inclusive.
The number of attacked cities m is between 1 and n inclusive.
The number of roads is exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct cities within the range 1 to n.
The number of attacked cities is exactly m.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= city <= n for city in attacked_cities)
preconditions.description: Each attacked city is within the range 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The teleport city is within the range 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= city <= n for city in attacked_cities)
postconditions.description: Each attacked city is within the range 1 to n.
The minimum time needed is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: all(teleport_city == return_value[0] and min_time == return_value[1] for return_value in [(teleport_city, min_time)])
postconditions.description: The output consists of the teleport city and the minimum time needed.

postconditions.expression: all(min_time == min(sum(distances[teleport_city][city] for city in attacked_cities) for teleport_city in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: The minimum time is the minimum sum of distances from the teleport city to all attacked cities.

postconditions.expression: all(teleport_city == min((city for city in range(1, n + 1)), key=lambda city: sum(distances[city][city2] for city2 in attacked_cities))
postconditions.description: The teleport city is the one that minimizes the sum of distances to all attacked cities.
